title: Disconnect the shop, and the front desk's view of Settings, are never tested
what: No test presses 'Disconnect the shop' on a real gym saved in the browser, and no test opens Settings as the front desk to check the backup, erase and offline-copy controls are hidden.
expected: One test disconnects the shop and checks members and payments stay; one test opens Settings as the desk and checks the owner-only controls are not there.
fix_line: Add a disconnect test and a desk Settings test

title: The risky paths of the gym's records card are never tested: unsent money on clear, a failed backup, Cancel on erase
what: Tests check the calm 'Clear offline copy' question only with nothing waiting. The red question that names unsent desk work, a backup that fails ('Could not make the file'), Cancel on 'Erase everything?' and the demo's 'never put online' line are never checked. The backup test checks members and payments in the file but not check-ins.
expected: Tests for clearing with unsent money waiting, a failed backup, Cancel on erase, and check-ins in the backup file.
fix_line: Add tests for the unsent-money clear, failed backup and erase cancel

title: Set up your gym: a hand tick surviving a refresh, and the row's look once done, are never tested
what: The test counts ticks but never checks that 'Mark done' leaves the row, that a tick survives a reload, that the done step is struck through, or that the 'You can still open it' line shows before moving the page.
expected: The test reloads after a hand tick and checks the row and count stay done.
fix_line: Add a reload and row check after a hand tick

title: Today for a brand-new gym, and the empty words of its three lists, are never tested
what: No test opens Today for a gym with no records and checks there is no wall of zero tiles, and no test reads 'Nobody to follow up', 'Everyone has paid' or 'Start checking members in'. The list rows (at most 6, 'See all', archived dues still counted) are never checked either.
expected: A test of a new gym's Today and of each list's empty words and rows.
fix_line: Add a Today test for a new gym and for the list rows

title: What the front desk sees on Today is only half tested: the weekly money card and the came-in card are never checked for the desk
what: Tests check the desk sees no collection or fees tile, but never that the desk gets no 'Last week at your gym' card with money, never open the came-in card as the desk, and never check that the desk's check-ins and renewals move the people counts.
expected: A desk test on Today that checks the weekly card is hidden, the came-in card shows no total, and the counts follow the desk's work.
fix_line: Add a desk Today test for the weekly and came-in cards

title: Your numbers: the 'Part of the Pro pack' card and the no-check-ins lines are never tested
what: No test shows the Pro pack card for a Starter gym (owner or desk), the switch from the card to the numbers, or the '–' with 'Check members in to see this' when the register was never used.
expected: Tests for the plan gate both ways and for a gym with no check-ins.
fix_line: Add tests for the Pro card and the no-check-in numbers

title: The 'Messages to send' card's buttons and its plans-ending row are never tested
what: Only the birthday count words are checked. No test presses 'Send wishes' or 'Remind them', checks the Messages page opens with the right group picked, checks the plans-ending row, or checks the card is hidden for the desk or when nobody needs a message.
expected: A test that taps each row's button and checks the group, and desk and empty cases.
fix_line: Add a Today test for the Messages to send buttons

title: The 'Workout offer' card on Today is never tested
what: Only the count of ready rewards is checked as data. No test shows the card, its '1 reward' or '2 rewards' words, the 'Give' button, the desk's view, or the card going away after the rewards are given.
expected: A test for the card for owner and desk, and after giving.
fix_line: Add a Today test for the Workout offer card

title: The WhatsApp button on each Today row is never tested
what: No test checks that a row's WhatsApp button opens that member's own number in a new tab with an empty message, or what happens when the saved number is empty or short. A wrong number would open a chat with a stranger.
expected: A test that reads each row's link and checks the member's number, the new tab and the no-referrer setting, plus a member with a bad number.
fix_line: Add a test of the Today row WhatsApp links

title: Trainers: the week buttons, the load error, the gym-not-online state and a removed trainer are never tested
what: Tests cover the not-ready and no-trainers states and day chips, but never 'Last week' / 'Next week' / 'This week', 'Could not load your trainers', 'Trainer pages need your gym online', the non-owner empty words, or a trainer whose tick was taken off.
expected: Tests for each of these states.
fix_line: Add Trainers tests for weeks, errors and a removed trainer

title: Most booking-sheet refusals are checked only in the logic, never on screen; the other two ways in are never opened
what: The past time, 31 days ahead, all classes already booked, no member picked, no start time and 'No member with this name' words are never seen in a test. 'Book personal training' under the grid and 'Book with <name>' are never pressed, so the known past-week day bug has no test. Booking again after a cancel is not tested.
expected: Screen tests for each refusal and for both other ways into the sheet, including a past week on a trainer's page.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the booking refusals and entries

title: A booking that has started, opened by a non-owner, and a failed cancel are never tested on screen
what: The rule that only the owner can cancel after the start is tested in the logic and on the server, but no screen test checks the button is gone and the words show, that a failed cancel keeps the sheet open, or that a booking opens from a trainer's page.
expected: Screen tests for the started booking as desk and owner, and for a failed cancel.
fix_line: Add screen tests for started and failed cancels

title: The trainer page editor's photo, 80-letter limit, mixed-hours warning and a trainer editing their own page are never tested on screen
what: Only a text and two-shift save is tested. No test adds or removes a photo, picks a bad photo, checks the 80-letter hint and cut, shows the 'same hours on every day' warning, clears hours, drops an edit, or signs in as a trainer to edit their own page.
expected: Screen tests for each of these.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the trainer page editor
